score_interpretation.label: Limited Evidence Coverage
score_interpretation.description: Available evidence supports a preliminary assessment; key historical financial reports or operational documentation remain incomplete.

positive_evidence: Valid legal registration record identified under Society.
Permanent Account Number (PAN) was verified against statutory records.
Section 12A/12AB charitable tax-exempt registration is active.
Active Foreign Contribution Regulation Act (FCRA) registration verified.
Reported financial totals reconcile mathematically with itemized expense categories.
Core financial disclosures (income, expenditure, assets, liabilities) are complete.
negative_evidence: Auditor issued a qualified report noting specific reservations or missing disclosures.
statistical_findings: Isolation Forest flagged an unusual financial distribution (e.g. skewed admin ratio or high concentration).
Programme expense ratio is 44.0% (Peer group median: 78.0%).
Administrative expense ratio is 48.0% (Peer group median: 10.0%).
missing_evidence: Section 80G tax benefit certificate is not documented.
Latest financial statement is from FY2024-25; recency decay applied.
No publicly documented projects or operational track records were located.

major_uncertainty_sources: Public evidence is self-reported or platform-extracted; requires statutory registry confirmation.

limitations: The assessment is based strictly on observable public evidence and does not establish moral character, honesty, or fraud.
Missing public documentation does not prove absence of charitable activity or operational wrongdoing.
Statistical anomaly detection flags unusual distributions, not misuse of funds.

darpan_info.disclaimer: Verified against local statutory registry reference cache for validation.
